forecast_quality.conclusion: The Pinnacle closing market produced lower out-of-sample log loss than the model.

chronological_strategy.conclusion: Observed profitability was positive, but the uncertainty interval included zero.

fractional_kelly.conclusion: Increasing Kelly exposure amplified estimation error and drawdown risk. Half Kelly lost money.

closing_line_value.conclusion: There was no statistically reliable evidence of persistent positive closing-line value.

overall_conclusion: The model captured useful football structure and occasionally produced profitable historical betting sequences, but it did not outperform the Pinnacle closing market on probability quality and did not demonstrate a stable informational pricing edge.
